variants.name: 11.4 kg
variants.about_this_item:
Limited ingredient doesn’t mean less meat. ACANA™ Singles Free-run Duck is loaded with 50%* quality duck ingredients in WholePrey ratios, complemented with whole, delicious Bartlett pears, providing your dog with the protein and nutrients they need in order to stay happy, healthy, and strong.

1. 50% DUCK INGREDIENTS* | 31% PROTEIN2. 1/2 FRESH OR RAW** DUCK | NUTRIENT-RICH3. WHOLEPREY | DUCK, ORGANS, AND BONE – SUPERFOOD FOR DOGS4. FREEZE-DRY INFUSED | INTENSE NATURAL FLAVOUR5. WHOLE VEGETABLES, FRUIT & BOTANICALS | FRESH6. NO GRAIN INGREDIENTS***

*Approximate and derived from the unprocessed state of the ingredients.**Our fresh ingredients use refrigeration as the sole method of preservation and our raw ingredients are frozen at the peak of freshness to preserve nutrients.*** Produced in a facility that processes grains
variants.ingredient_information:
Composition

Fresh duck (18%), duck meat meal (17%), whole green peas, whole red lentils, fresh duck giblets (liver, heart, kidney) (7%), duck fat (6%), fresh bartlett pears (4%), whole garbanzo beans, whole green lentils, whole yellow peas, dried duck cartilage (2%), lentil fiber, marine algae (1.2%) (pure and sustainable source of DHA and EPA), fresh whole butternut squash, fresh whole pumpkin, dried brown kelp, freeze-dried duck liver (0.1%), salt, fresh whole cranberries, fresh whole blueberries, chicory root, turmeric root, milk thistle, burdock root, lavender, marshmallow root, rosehips.

Analytical constituents

Crude protein 31% Fat content 15% Crude fibre 5% Crude ash 7.5% Moisture 12% Calcium 1.3% Phosphorus 0.9% Omega-3 fatty acids 0.8% Omega-6 fatty acids 2.2% DHA (docosahexaenoic acid) 0.15% EPA (eicosapentaenoic acid) 0.1%
